project_type: Python Telegram bot using aiogram 3.x with Firebase Realtime DB
verification_instructions: 1. Run python syntax check on bot.py. 2. Verify no import errors with basic import test.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages or run the bot. Use AST validation only.
contribution_requirements: Single-file bot (bot.py). All code in one file. Reply keyboard only (no inline keyboards for navigation). Firebase Realtime DB for persistence.
key_patterns: aiogram 3.x FSM states, Reply Keyboard navigation, unicode bold button text via _b() helper, Firebase CRUD helpers, in-memory sessions for mail/tempmail
directory_structure: Single-file project: bot.py is the entire application, requirements.txt for deps, Procfile/railway.toml for deployment
